subject: variable: add system variable 'tidb_resource_control_strict_mode' (#54033)
summary: Adds global sysvar `tidb_resource_control_strict_mode` (default ON for new clusters) to gate dynamic privilege enforcement for changing session resource group (`SET RESOURCE GROUP`) and applying `RESOURCE_GROUP` statement hints. Introduces bootstrap upgrade v199 to initialize the new global variable to OFF on upgrade (when absent) to preserve legacy behavior; runtime flag is backed by `variable.EnableResourceControlStrictMode` atomic updated via sysvar cache rebuild and SET GLOBAL hook.
